meta.description: Pakistan NPK recommendations — user-supplied data (2026-10-13 batch of 25 crops + 2026-10-14 batch of 17 crops) with authentic Pakistani research sources (AARI, PARC, NARC, BARI, CCRI, MMRI, RRI, SRI, WRI, etc.). All per-acre values converted to per-hectare (x2.47105). 3 non-commercial crops (cocoa, lupins, yam) flagged as no verified data.

records.applicationMethod: Starter nitrogen only — soybean is a legume fixing atmospheric nitrogen; apply Bradyrhizobium japonicum inoculant on seed (mandatory). All NPK via band placement at sowing.
records.applicationTiming: All NPK as band placement at sowing.
records.notes: N 10–12 kg/acre (≈½ bag urea); P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre (≈½ bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: All NPK applied at sowing. Gypsum (100–150 kg/acre) broadcast at flowering/pegging stage and covered with soil (earthing up).
records.applicationTiming: All NPK at sowing. Gypsum at flowering/pegging stage, then earthing up.
records.micronutrients: Gypsum 247–371 kg/ha (100–150 kg/acre) — calcium & sulphur essential for pod development; prevents empty pods/pops.
records.notes: N 10–12 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 30–35 kg/acre (≈1.5 bags DAP); K₂O 15–25 kg/acre (≈½–1 bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: All phosphorus and potash at sowing. Half the urea at sowing, remaining half at first irrigation. In barani (rainfed) areas, apply all fertilizer at sowing.
records.applicationTiming: All P & K at sowing. Half N at sowing, half at first irrigation. Barani: all at sowing.
records.notes: N 35–45 kg/acre (≈1.5 bags urea); P₂O₅ 23 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre (≈½ bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: Phosphorus and potash at land preparation. Nitrogen in 2 splits (at sowing and first irrigation). Sulphur 8–10 kg/acre for oil quality.
records.applicationTiming: P & K at land preparation. N split: sowing + first irrigation.
records.micronutrients: Sulphur 19.8–24.7 kg/ha (8–10 kg/acre) — essential for oil synthesis and glucosinolate balance.
records.notes: N 40–50 kg/acre (≈1.75–2 bags urea); P₂O₅ 30–35 kg/acre (≈1.5 bags DAP); K₂O 20–25 kg/acre (≈1 bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: All DAP and SOP at sowing. Nitrogen in 2 splits — at first irrigation and at bud stage before flowering.
records.applicationTiming: All DAP & SOP at sowing. N in 2 splits: first irrigation + bud stage (pre-flowering).
records.notes: N 50–60 kg/acre (≈2–2.5 bags urea); P₂O₅ 30–35 kg/acre (≈1.5 bags DAP); K₂O 25 kg/acre (≈1 bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: Phosphorus and potash at sowing. Nitrogen split between sowing and pre-flowering irrigation.
records.applicationTiming: P & K at sowing. N split: sowing + pre-flowering irrigation.
records.notes: N 20–25 kg/acre (≈1 bag urea); P₂O₅ 23 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre (≈½ bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: Starter nitrogen dose (legume). All fertilizer incorporated into the soil at sowing. Potash where soil is deficient.
records.applicationTiming: All fertilizer at sowing, incorporated into soil.
records.notes: N 10–12 kg/acre (starter); P₂O₅ 23 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 10–12 kg/acre if deficient.

records.applicationMethod: Starter nitrogen (legume). In Thal and barani areas, apply at sowing through seed drill with or slightly below the seed.
records.applicationTiming: At sowing via seed drill, with or slightly below seed.
records.notes: N 10–15 kg/acre (starter); P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre (≈1–1.5 bags DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Phosphorus and potash at sowing. Half the nitrogen at sowing, remaining half at vining/pod formation stage.
records.applicationTiming: P & K at sowing; half N at sowing, half at vining/pod formation.
records.notes: N 15–20 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 30–35 kg/acre; K₂O 15–20 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Rainfed (barani): apply all fertilizer at sowing.
records.applicationTiming: All fertilizer at sowing (barani).
records.notes: Barani N 25–30 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 20–23 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Irrigated: split nitrogen in 2 doses; P and K at sowing.
records.applicationTiming: N split in 2 doses (irrigated).
records.notes: Irrigated N 40–45 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 20–23 kg/acre (≈1 bag DAP); K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Phosphorus and potash at sowing. Nitrogen split at first and second irrigation to keep grain protein content high.
records.applicationTiming: P & K at sowing; N split at 1st and 2nd irrigation.
records.notes: N 50–60 kg/acre (≈2.5 bags urea); P₂O₅ 35–46 kg/acre (≈1.5–2 bags DAP); K₂O 25 kg/acre (≈1 bag SOP).

records.applicationMethod: Hardy grain for poor soils. All phosphorus and potash at sowing; modest nitrogen.
records.applicationTiming: All P & K at sowing.
records.notes: N 25–35 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 18–23 kg/acre; K₂O 12–15 kg/acre. Quetta/Gilgit high-altitude context.
records.source_org: PARC High Altitude Agriculture Research Institute (HAARI)

records.applicationMethod: Same method as wheat. Split nitrogen for fodder or grain purpose.
records.applicationTiming: N split (as wheat), for fodder or grain.
records.notes: N 40–45 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre; K₂O 15–20 kg/acre.
records.source_org: Nuclear Institute for Agriculture and Biology (NIAB), Faisalabad

records.applicationMethod: Phosphorus and potash at sowing. Nitrogen split — at sowing and after each cutting (fodder).
records.applicationTiming: P & K at sowing; N split: sowing + after each cutting.
records.notes: N 45–55 kg/acre (≈2 bags urea); P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre (≈1–1.5 bags DAP); K₂O 15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Grain purpose. All phosphorus + half nitrogen at sowing; remaining N at first irrigation or after rain.
records.applicationTiming: All P + half N at sowing; rest of N at first irrigation/rain.
records.notes: Grain N 30–35 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 20–23 kg/acre; K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Fodder purpose (higher N). All phosphorus + half nitrogen at sowing; remaining N at first irrigation or after rain.
records.applicationTiming: All P + half N at sowing; rest of N at first irrigation/rain.
records.notes: Fodder N 45–50 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 20–23 kg/acre; K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Grain purpose. All DAP at sowing; urea at first irrigation and knee-high stage.
records.applicationTiming: All DAP at sowing; urea at 1st irrigation + knee-high stage.
records.notes: Grain N 35–40 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre; K₂O 15–20 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Fodder purpose (higher N). All DAP at sowing; urea at first irrigation and knee-high stage.
records.applicationTiming: All DAP at sowing; urea at 1st irrigation + knee-high stage.
records.notes: Fodder N 50–60 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre; K₂O 15–20 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Grown in Northern Areas (Gilgit-Baltistan, Skardu). Excess nitrogen causes lodging — apply balanced, low nitrogen at sowing.
records.applicationTiming: Balanced low N at sowing.
records.notes: N 15–20 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 15–20 kg/acre; K₂O 12–15 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Potash-loving crop. All phosphorus and potash at sowing. Nitrogen after thinning and during canopy development. STOP nitrogen 40 days before root maturity (protects sugar content).
records.applicationTiming: All P & K at sowing; N after thinning + canopy; stop N 40 days before maturity.
records.notes: N 50–60 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 35–45 kg/acre; K₂O 40–50 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Excess nitrogen grows vines at the expense of tubers. Potash essential for tuber bulking. Apply P and K at bed formation.
records.applicationTiming: P & K at bed formation.
records.notes: N 25–35 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 23–30 kg/acre; K₂O 40–50 kg/acre.
records.source_org_2: National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC), Horticultural Sciences

records.applicationMethod: Experimental scale in Pakistan (coastal & southern Punjab/Sindh belt). High-potash crop. Apply fertilizer at 30 and 60 days after planting stem cuttings.
records.applicationTiming: Fertilizer at 30 and 60 days after planting stem cuttings.
records.notes: N 35–45 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 20–25 kg/acre; K₂O 45–60 kg/acre.

records.applicationMethod: Fiber crop needing vegetative biomass. Phosphorus and potash at sowing; nitrogen split (sowing + after weeding).
records.applicationTiming: P & K at sowing; N split: sowing + after weeding.
records.notes: N 25–30 kg/acre; P₂O₅ 15–20 kg/acre; K₂O 15–20 kg/acre.
records.source_org: Ayub Agricultural Research Institute (AARI), Fiber Section

records.applicationMethod: SOURCE DOSE IS PER MATURE TREE/YEAR: N 500–600 g (≈1.2 kg urea), P₂O₅ 300–350 g (≈700 g DAP), K₂O 1000–1200 g (≈2–2.4 kg SOP) + 1–2 kg common salt. Per-hectare values above assume 175 palms/ha (7.5m × 7.5m spacing). For coastal Sindh (Thatta, Badin) & Balochistan. Apply twice yearly (March and September/monsoon) in a circular trench around the tree, then cover.
records.applicationTiming: Twice yearly: March + September/monsoon, in circular trench, covered with soil.
records.micronutrients: Common salt (NaCl) 175–350 kg/ha (1–2 kg/tree/year) — chlorine is an essential micronutrient for coconut.
records.notes: Per-tree dose; experimental/limited scale in coastal pockets. Density assumption: 175 palms/ha.
records.source_org: Coastal Agricultural Research Station (CARS), PARC, Thatta, Sindh

records.applicationMethod: SOURCE DOSE IS PER MATURE TREE/YEAR: N 600–800 g, P₂O₅ 400–500 g, K₂O 1200–1500 g + Mg 250–300 g (kieserite). Per-hectare values above assume 143 palms/ha (9m triangular spacing). Per Pakistan Oil Palm Development Project (Thatta/Sindh coastal belt) trials: 2–3 applications per year in the weeded ring.
records.applicationTiming: 2–3 applications/year in the weeded circle around the tree.
records.notes: Per-tree dose; experimental coastal belt. Density assumption: 143 palms/ha.
records.source_org: Pakistan Oil Palm Development Project (PODB/PARC), Thatta
records.source_title: Oil Palm NPK recommendation — per tree/year (Pakistan)

records.applicationMethod: SOURCE DOSE IS PER MATURE PLANT/YEAR: N 100–150 g, P₂O₅ 50–70 g, K₂O 100–150 g. Per-hectare values above assume ~1600 plants/ha. Northern sub-tropical foothills (KP/Hazara/Rawalpindi research stations), small-scale experimental plots only. Two splits per year (pre-flowering and monsoon).
records.applicationTiming: Two splits/year: pre-flowering + monsoon.
records.notes: Per-plant dose; experimental only. Density assumption: ~1600 plants/ha.
records.source_org_2: National Tea and High Value Crops Research Institute (NATHVRI), Shinkiari (KP)

records.applicationMethod: SOURCE DOSE IS PER MATURE TREE/YEAR: N 120–150 g, P₂O₅ 100–120 g, K₂O 100–120 g + Mg 25–30 g. Per-hectare values above assume ~450 trees/ha. Not grown commercially in Pakistan — tropical trials under forestry/agroforestry pilots only. Two applications per year (spring and late summer).
records.applicationTiming: Two applications/year: spring + late summer.
records.notes: Per-tree dose; pilot trials only, no commercial production. Density assumption: ~450 trees/ha.
records.source_title: Natural Rubber (Hevea) NPK recommendation — per tree/year (Pakistan)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 100% starter N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Maintenance: water-run booster after every 2 cuts.
records.applicationMethod: Legume fodder — fixes atmospheric nitrogen; starter N essential. Apply all P2O5, all K2O and starter N as basal at final seedbed preparation. After every 2-3 cuts, top-dress 25 kg/ha P2O5 + light urea (15 kg/ha N) with irrigation.
records.notes: N 10-15 kg/acre (~0.25 bag urea starter); P2O5 32-45 kg/acre (1.5-2 bags DAP); K2O 20-26 kg/acre (0.5-1 bag SOP). Zones: Punjab (Sargodha, Kasur), Sindh (Sukkur, Hyderabad), Balochistan upland valleys.

records.applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).
records.applicationMethod: Apply 100% NPK at sowing via furrow placement below or beside the seed (band placement). Common bean nodulation is weaker than other pulses, so starter N is essential — but excess N causes pod drop.
records.notes: N 12-18 kg/acre (~0.35 bag urea starter); P2O5 22-30 kg/acre (1-1.25 bags DAP); K2O 12-20 kg/acre (~0.5 bag SOP). Zones: KPK (Swat, Hazara), Gilgit-Baltistan, Northern Punjab. NOTE: distinct from existing pk25 'bean' (merged rajmash/cowpea record) — this is Phaseolus vulgaris specifically.
records.source_org: PARC / National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC), Islamabad (Pulses Program)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 1/3 N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. 1st split 20-25 DAT (rosette stage). 2nd split 40-45 DAT (head formation initiation; stop N 15 days before harvest).
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O and 1/3 N as basal on ridges at transplanting. Side-dress remaining N in two splits for compact head formation.
records.notes: N 50-60 kg/acre (~2.5 bags urea); P2O5 25-32 kg/acre (1-1.3 bags DAP); K2O 25-32 kg/acre (1 bag SOP). Zones: Central Punjab (Sheikhupura, Faisalabad), KPK valleys (Peshawar, Swat).
records.source_org: Vegetable Research Institute (VRI), Ayub Agricultural Research Institute (AARI), Faisalabad

records.applicationTiming: Basal / 1st irrigation (0-30 DAS): 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O + 1/3 N. 2nd split at squaring (45-55 DAS): 1/3 N. 3rd split at peak flowering to boll setting (70-80 DAS): 1/3 N (complete by end of August).
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O and Boron at sowing or first irrigation. Split nitrogen into 3 equal doses to avoid vegetative overgrowth and maximize boll loading.
records.notes: N 60-80 kg/acre (3-3.5 bags urea); P2O5 25-35 kg/acre (1-1.5 bags DAP); K2O 20-30 kg/acre (1 bag SOP). Zones: Southern Punjab (Multan, Bahawalpur, Khanewal), Sindh (Nawabshah, Sanghar, Mirpurkhas).

records.applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).
records.applicationMethod: Drill 100% fertilizer into the prepared seedbed at sowing (por/drill).
records.notes: N 8-12 kg/acre (~0.25 bag urea starter); P2O5 20-26 kg/acre (1 bag DAP); K2O 12-16 kg/acre (~0.5 bag SOP). Zones: Pothwar rainfed tract (Chakwal, Rawalpindi), Southern Punjab, Lower Sindh.

records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress at 30-35 DAS (tillering): 50% N.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O and 1/2 N at sowing; top-dress remaining 1/2 N at tillering with rain or irrigation.
records.notes: N 18-25 kg/acre (~1 bag urea); P2O5 12-18 kg/acre (0.5-0.75 bag DAP); K2O 8-12 kg/acre (0.5 bag SOP). Zones: marginal barani lands of Northern Punjab, KPK, Rawalpindi Division.
records.source_org: Minor Crops Wing, PARC / NARC, Islamabad

records.micronutrients: SOP strictly preferred for K (sugar content & berry firmness)
records.applicationTiming: Late winter / dormancy break (Feb, 0 DAP): all P2O5 + 40% K2O + 1/3 N. Post-fruit set / berry sizing (Apr-May): 1/3 N + 30% K2O. Veraison / colour turn (Jun): 1/3 N + 30% K2O (stop N completely after veraison).
records.applicationMethod: Apply P and K at end of dormancy via trenching/chokha method and cover with soil. Split N and potash from spring restart through fruit sizing.
records.notes: N 32-48 kg/acre; P2O5 20-30 kg/acre; K2O 40-60 kg/acre. Zones: Balochistan (Pishin, Quetta, Mastung), Pothwar plateau (Chakwal, Attock).

records.micronutrients: Zinc (Zn 33%): 15 kg/ha — prevents white bud / khaira disease
records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): full P + full K + full Zn + 20% N. Knee-high stage V6 / 4-5 leaves (25-30 DAS): 40% N. Pre-tasseling V10-V12 (45-55 DAS): 40% N.
records.applicationMethod: Band all P2O5, all K2O and zinc at sowing. Split nitrogen into 3 doses.
records.notes: N 80-100 kg/acre (3.5-4.5 bags urea); P2O5 36-50 kg/acre (1.5-2 bags DAP); K2O 30-40 kg/acre (1-1.5 bags SOP). Zones: Sahiwal, Okara, Pakpattan, Faisalabad; KPK (Mardan, Swabi). Spring & autumn hybrids.
records.source_org: Maize, Sorghum and Millet Research Institute (MMRI), Yusafwala (Sahiwal)
records.source_org_2: Cereal Crops Research Institute (CCRI) Pirsabak, Nowshera (KPK)

records.applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).
records.applicationMethod: Drill 100% fertilizer at sowing near the seed via band placement. Excess nitrogen produces only foliage and no pods.
records.notes: N 8-12 kg/acre (~0.25 bag urea starter); P2O5 20-26 kg/acre (1 bag DAP); K2O 10-16 kg/acre (~0.5 bag SOP). Zones: Thal tract (Bhakkar, Layyah, Mianwali), Southern Punjab.

records.micronutrients: Boron (Solubor 20%): 1.5-2.5 kg/ha foliar spray for fruit setting
records.applicationTiming: Post-harvest / dormancy (Jan): 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O + 1/3 N. Pre-bloom / spring flush (Mar): 1/3 N + foliar boron. Pit hardening / fruit sizing (May-Jun): 1/3 N + 50% K2O.
records.applicationMethod: Apply P, K and 1/3 N during winter dormancy (January) in a ring trench under the canopy drip-line. Split remaining N at spring flush and pit hardening.
records.notes: N 28-40 kg/acre (mature bearing orchard); P2O5 16-24 kg/acre; K2O 36-52 kg/acre (oil synthesis & fruit-drop control). Zones: Pothwar Olive Valley (Chakwal, Rawalpindi), KPK (Nowshera, Swat), Balochistan.
records.source_org: BARI, Chakwal (Center of Excellence for Olive Research)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O. Top-dress at 25-30 DAS: 50% N.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, all K2O and 1/2 N at sowing; top-dress remaining 1/2 N at tillering with first irrigation or good rain.
records.notes: N 20-30 kg/acre (1-1.5 bags urea); P2O5 14-20 kg/acre (0.75-1 bag DAP); K2O 10-14 kg/acre (0.5 bag SOP). Zones: Rawalpindi, Attock, Chakwal, Thal, Tharparkar (Sindh).
records.source_org: Maize, Sorghum and Millet Research Institute (MMRI), Yusafwala (Sahiwal)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at transplanting (0 DAT): 100% P2O5 + 30% K2O + 20% N. 1st top-dress 30 DAT (branching): 30% N. 2nd top-dress 55-60 DAT (flowering): 25% N + 35% K2O. 3rd top-dress 80-90 DAT (peak picking): 25% N + 35% K2O.
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5 and 1/3 K2O on ridges before transplanting; deliver N and remaining K in 3 splits across flowering and multiple picking flushes.
records.notes: N 50-65 kg/acre (2.5-3 bags urea); P2O5 25-35 kg/acre (1-1.5 bags DAP); K2O 25-36 kg/acre (1-1.25 bags SOP). Zones: Sindh (Kunri, Mirpurkhas, Umerkot — 85% of national output), Southern Punjab.
records.source_org: Agricultural Research Institute (ARI) Tandojam, Sindh (Chilli Research Station, Kunri)

records.applicationTiming: 100% basal at sowing (0 DAS).
records.applicationMethod: Drill all fertilizer at sowing 5 cm below seed level (band placement). The deep taproot system means no subsequent split is needed.
records.notes: N 10-14 kg/acre (starter); P2O5 20-28 kg/acre (1-1.25 bags DAP); K2O 10-16 kg/acre (~0.5 bag SOP). Zones: rainfed & irrigated borders of Punjab & Sindh.

records.micronutrients: Zinc sulphate (33%): 12.5-15 kg/ha (5-6 kg/acre) — khaira/haddoo disease prevention
records.applicationTiming: Basal (0-5 DAT): 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O + 1/3 N (+ Zn at 15-20 DAT). 1st top-dress 25-30 DAT (maximum tillering): 1/3 N. 2nd top-dress 45-50 DAT (panicle primordia): 1/3 N (in Basmati, no N after 50 DAT to avoid lodging).
records.applicationMethod: Incorporate all P2O5, all K2O and zinc into puddled soil before last planking. Broadcast nitrogen in 2-3 splits into standing water.
records.notes: N: Basmati 110-140 kg/ha (45-55 kg/acre, 2-2.5 bags urea); Coarse IRRI 140-170 kg/ha. P2O5 25-35 kg/acre (1-1.5 bags DAP); K2O 20-28 kg/acre (1 bag SOP). Varieties: Super Basmati, Kainat 1121, IRRI-6. Zones: Kalar basin Punjab (Gujranwala, Sheikhupura, Hafizabad), Lower Sindh (Badin, Thatta).
records.source_org: Rice Research Institute (RRI), Kala Shah Kaku (Punjab)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting (0 DAP): 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O + 30% N + 100% S. 1st split 20-25 DAP: 35% N. 2nd split 40-45 DAP (bulb enlargement): 35% N + 50% K2O (stop N 25 days before harvest).
records.applicationMethod: Apply all P2O5, sulphur and 1/2 K2O as basal; split N and remaining K2O across vegetative growth and early bulbing.
records.notes: N 36-48 kg/acre (2 bags urea); P2O5 20-28 kg/acre (1-1.25 bags DAP); K2O 25-36 kg/acre (1-1.25 bags SOP). Zones: Sindh & coastal belts.

records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting (Feb-Mar, 0 DAP): 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O + 20% N. Tillering stage (45-60 DAP): 40% N. Earthing-up (90-100 DAP / pre-monsoon): 40% N + 50% K2O.
records.applicationMethod: Band all P2O5 and 1/2 K2O in sowing trenches/furrows below the setts. Split nitrogen into 3 doses. No N after end of June (protects sucrose content).
records.notes: N 80-110 kg/acre (4-5 bags urea; ratoons need 25% higher N); P2O5 40-52 kg/acre (2-2.5 bags DAP); K2O 40-56 kg/acre (2 bags SOP — for sugar recovery %). Zones: Central/Southern Punjab (Faisalabad, Rahim Yar Khan), Sindh, KPK (Mardan).
records.source_org_2: National Sugar Crops Research Institute (NSCRI), Thatta (Sindh)

records.applicationTiming: Basal at sowing (0 DAS): 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O + 1/3 N. 1st irrigation / crown root initiation (20-25 DAS): 1/3 N. 2nd irrigation / stem elongation (50-55 DAS): 1/3 N (complete N before booting).
records.applicationMethod: Drill all P2O5, all K2O and 1/3 N at sowing. Apply remaining N with first and second irrigation.
records.notes: N: irrigated 120-160 kg/ha (50-65 kg/acre, 2.5-3 bags urea); barani 60-90 kg/ha. P2O5 35-46 kg/acre (1.5-2 bags DAP); K2O 20-26 kg/acre (1 bag SOP). Varieties: Akbar-19, Dilkash-20, Ghazi-19, Fakhar-e-Bhakkar. Zones: Punjab (irrigated & barani), Sindh, KPK, Balochistan.
